name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog:
* Security: files a push asks to delete must be inside the theme or plugin folder being pushed; anything else is refused.
* Security and a fix: Undo restores a backup only into the theme or plugin folder it was made from (undoing a plugin push no longer touches the theme), never into uploads or any wider folder, and only from WebsitePusher's own backups, each file checked first.
* Backup names can't be guessed, and the backups folder is closed to the web on newer Apache too.
